questions.explanationZh: 老年人不发热并不能排除 sepsis（脓毒症）：很多人体温正常甚至偏低，而 35.8°C 加上心动过速、呼吸增快、低血压和再充盈延长，反而更令人担忧而不是更安心。尿路来源的感染以“功能状态下降”起病，是这个年龄段最常见的模式。单纯脱水可以排除：单靠脱水不会造成这么快的呼吸加体温偏低加 4 秒再充盈；即使存在，也是结果而不是病因。Stroke（卒中）可以排除：无局灶体征，且是数天而非突发。“正常老化”永远不能拿来解释急性功能下降，选它就是老年患者被低估分类的根源。处理：给氧、按不稳定患者处理并转运。

questions.questionEn: A 79-year-old man on apixaban tripped on a rug two hours ago and struck his forehead. He did not lose consciousness and says he 'feels fine'. HR 76, RR 16, BP 152/88, SpO2 97% on room air, GCS 15, blood glucose 5.9 mmol/L. There is a small forehead haematoma, no neurological deficit and no vomiting. His family asks whether he can simply stay home. Which statement is correct?
questions.questionZh: 一名 79 岁、在服 apixaban（抗凝药）的男性两小时前被地毯绊倒，前额撞地。没有意识丧失，他说自己“没事”。HR 76，RR 16，BP 152/88，室内空气下 SpO2 97%，GCS 15，血糖 5.9 mmol/L。前额有一处小血肿，无神经系统缺损，无呕吐。家属问能不能就让他在家休息。下列哪一项正确？

options.en: The mechanism is trivial and he can safely stay home
options.zh: 受伤机制很轻，在家观察是安全的

options.en: Anticoagulation means a significant intracranial bleed can develop despite a GCS of 15 and a minor mechanism, so transport and monitor GCS serially, elevate the head of the bed 30 degrees, keep SpO2 at or above 94%, and at PCP level maintain a systolic BP above 120 mmHg and a blood glucose of 4.0–8.0 mmol/L
options.zh: 抗凝意味着即使 GCS 15 且机制很轻，也可能发展出严重颅内出血；应转运、连续监测 GCS、床头抬高 30 度、维持 SpO2 ≥ 94%，PCP 还要维持收缩压 > 120 mmHg、血糖 4.0–8.0 mmol/L

options.en: A GCS of 15 excludes a traumatic brain injury
options.zh: GCS 15 就可以排除颅脑损伤

options.en: He only needs assessment if he starts vomiting
options.zh: 只有开始呕吐才需要去评估

questions.explanationEn: The BC guidelines direct you to suspect a traumatic brain injury in any patient with head trauma and any altered level of consciousness, and anticoagulation shifts the threshold much lower: a subdural or intracerebral bleed can expand over hours in a patient who currently looks and scores completely normal. Option A weighs the mechanism alone and ignores the drug. Option C confuses a current score with a prognosis — a GCS of 13 or above indicates a mild injury at this moment, not the absence of a bleed. Option D waits for a late sign; by the time he vomits the bleed has already expanded. Note that tranexamic acid is contraindicated in isolated traumatic brain injury, so it has no place here.
questions.explanationZh: BC 指引规定：只要有头部创伤且伴任何意识改变，就要怀疑颅脑损伤；而抗凝治疗把这个阈值拉得更低——硬膜下或脑内出血可以在一个当下看起来、评分也完全正常的患者身上数小时内扩大。A 项只看受伤机制，完全忽略了药物。C 项把“当下评分”当成了“预后”——GCS ≥ 13 只代表此刻属于轻度损伤，不代表没有出血。D 项在等一个晚期体征；等到他呕吐，血肿早已扩大。另请注意：tranexamic acid 在孤立性颅脑损伤中是禁忌的，本例不适用。

questions.questionEn: An 83-year-old woman with mild dementia became acutely agitated overnight and is now shouting at people who are not there. Her family says she was her usual chatty self two days ago. HR 104, RR 20, BP 128/76, SpO2 95% on room air, temperature 37.4°C, blood glucose 6.1 mmol/L. She has no focal weakness and no head injury, and she complains of burning when she passes urine. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.questionZh: 一名 83 岁、有轻度 dementia（痴呆）的女性一夜之间变得非常躁动，现在对着并不存在的人大喊。家属说两天前她还是平时那个爱聊天的样子。HR 104，RR 20，BP 128/76，室内空气下 SpO2 95%，体温 37.4°C，血糖 6.1 mmol/L。无局灶无力，无头部外伤，她诉说排尿时灼烧感。最可能的诊断是什么？

options.zh: dementia（痴呆）自然加重
Stroke（卒中）
新发的原发性精神疾病

options.en: Delirium caused by a urinary tract infection
options.zh: 尿路感染引起的 delirium（谵妄）

questions.explanationEn: An acute change over two days with a fluctuating course, hallucinations and a plausible physiological trigger — dysuria — is delirium superimposed on dementia. Worsening dementia is excluded: dementia progresses over months to years, not overnight, and the family's account of a clear baseline two days ago is the key piece of history. Stroke is excluded: there is no focal deficit and no single abrupt moment of onset. A new primary psychiatric illness at 83 is rare and is a diagnosis of exclusion; the burning urine points to a treatable cause that must be found and reported first. Note that delirium always means look for a cause — infection, hypoxia, hypoglycemia, medication, pain or retention — rather than simply managing the agitation.
questions.explanationZh: 两天内的急性改变、病情波动、出现幻觉，并且有一个合理的生理诱因（排尿灼烧），这是在 dementia 基础上叠加的 delirium（谵妄）。“痴呆自然加重”可以排除：痴呆是数月到数年的进程，不会一夜之间变这样，而家属提供的“两天前还一切如常”就是关键病史。Stroke（卒中）可以排除：无局灶体征，也没有一个突然的发病时刻。“新发原发性精神疾病”在 83 岁极少见，且属于排除性诊断；排尿灼烧指向一个必须先找出并交班的可治病因。记住：遇到 delirium 就要去找病因——感染、缺氧、低血糖、药物、疼痛或尿潴留——而不是只去处理躁动。

questions.questionEn: An 86-year-old woman with osteoporosis who takes long-term prednisone is found on her bathroom floor. She says she 'just slipped' and denies pain 'anywhere much'. HR 92, RR 18, BP 118/70, SpO2 96% on room air, temperature 36.0°C, GCS 15. Her right leg is shortened and externally rotated. Her pelvis is stable on gentle assessment and her spine is not tender. What is the most likely injury?
questions.questionZh: 一名 86 岁、有骨质疏松并长期服用 prednisone 的女性被发现倒在浴室地板上。她说自己“就是滑了一下”，并否认“哪里特别疼”。HR 92，RR 18，BP 118/70，室内空气下 SpO2 96%，体温 36.0°C，GCS 15。右腿短缩并外旋。轻柔检查下骨盆稳定，脊柱无压痛。最可能的损伤是什么？

options.zh: Proximal femur fracture（股骨近端/髋部骨折）
Posterior hip dislocation（髋关节后脱位）
Pelvic ring fracture（骨盆环骨折）
Lumbar compression fracture（腰椎压缩性骨折）

questions.explanationEn: A shortened and externally rotated leg after a fall is a proximal femur fracture until proven otherwise, and osteoporosis with long-term steroid use makes a low-energy fracture very likely. Posterior hip dislocation is the closest look-alike and is excluded by the rotation: it also shortens the limb but holds it internally rotated and adducted, the opposite direction. Pelvic ring fracture is excluded: the pelvis is explicitly stable on gentle assessment, and a pelvic fracture does not produce an isolated rotational deformity of one leg. Lumbar compression fracture is excluded: it is common in osteoporosis but presents with focal spinal tenderness and no limb deformity, and her spine is explicitly not tender. Note that older patients frequently under-report pain, so 'nothing hurts much' does not weigh against a fracture.
questions.explanationZh: 跌倒后出现下肢短缩加外旋，在排除之前就是股骨近端骨折；骨质疏松加长期激素使低能量骨折极其常见。Posterior hip dislocation（髋关节后脱位）是最接近的鉴别项，用“旋转方向”排除：它同样会短缩，但下肢是内旋内收，与本例正好相反。Pelvic ring fracture（骨盆环骨折）可以排除：题干明写轻柔检查下骨盆稳定，而且骨盆骨折不会只造成单侧下肢的旋转畸形。Lumbar compression fracture（腰椎压缩性骨折）可以排除：它在骨质疏松中很常见，但表现为脊柱局限压痛、无肢体畸形，而题干明写脊柱无压痛。请注意：老年患者普遍低报疼痛，所以“哪里都不怎么疼”并不能用来否定骨折。

questions.questionEn: Why do older adults with a serious infection frequently present without a fever?
questions.questionZh: 为什么患有严重感染的老年人很多都不发热？

options.en: They report their symptoms accurately, so a fever is simply being missed by the crew
options.zh: 他们对症状的描述很准确，只是急救员漏测了体温

options.en: Fever occurs only in viral infection, not bacterial infection
options.zh: 只有病毒感染才发热，细菌感染不发热

options.en: Age-related changes in thermoregulation and immune response blunt the febrile response, so a normal or low temperature is common
options.zh: 与年龄相关的体温调节和免疫反应变化会钝化发热反应，所以体温正常甚至偏低很常见

options.en: Their medications always suppress the infection itself
options.zh: 他们的药物总是会把感染本身压下去

questions.explanationEn: Blunted thermoregulation and an attenuated immune response mean a normal or subnormal temperature is common in older adults with serious infection, and hypothermia in sepsis carries a worse prognosis than fever — so an afebrile older patient with tachycardia, tachypnea and confusion should raise your suspicion, not lower it. Option A is the opposite of the truth: older adults frequently under-report symptoms, and the pattern is not a measurement error. Option B is simply false. Option D uses an absolute and misstates the pharmacology; steroids and antipyretics can further mask a fever, which reinforces rather than replaces the physiological explanation.
questions.explanationZh: 体温调节能力下降和免疫反应减弱，使得严重感染的老年人体温正常甚至偏低十分常见；而且脓毒症时体温偏低的预后比发热更差——所以一个不发热、但心动过速、呼吸增快、神智混乱的老年患者，应该让你更警惕而不是更安心。A 项正好说反了：老年人普遍低报症状，而且这个现象不是测量失误。B 项纯属错误。D 项用了绝对化措辞，且曲解了药理；激素和退热药确实会进一步掩盖发热，但那是对生理机制的补充，不是替代。

questions.questionEn: A 90-year-old man with chest pressure has a systolic BP of 104 mmHg and a heart rate of 88. He took tadalafil (Cialis) 30 hours ago. Which statement about nitroglycerin is correct?
questions.questionZh: 一名 90 岁男性有胸部压迫感，收缩压 104 mmHg，心率 88。他 30 小时前服用过 tadalafil（Cialis）。关于 nitroglycerin，下列哪一项正确？

options.en: Give it — 30 hours is beyond the 24-hour limit
options.zh: 可以给——已经过了 24 小时的限制

options.en: Withhold it — his systolic BP is below 110 mmHg, and tadalafil is contraindicated within 48 hours
options.zh: 不能给——他的收缩压低于 110 mmHg，而且 tadalafil 的禁忌窗口是 48 小时

options.en: Give it — the phosphodiesterase inhibitor rule applies only to Viagra
options.zh: 可以给——磷酸二酯酶抑制剂的规定只适用于 Viagra

options.en: Withhold it — solely because of his age
options.zh: 不能给——唯一理由是他年纪太大

questions.explanationEn: Two contraindications apply at the same time. His systolic BP of 104 mmHg is below the 110 mmHg threshold, and tadalafil (Cialis) carries a 48-hour window rather than the 24 hours that applies to Viagra and Levitra, so 30 hours is still inside it. Option A applies the wrong drug's window. Option C is factually wrong — the rule covers all three agents, with different intervals. Option D invents an age contraindication that does not exist; age alone never blocks a drug, although hypotension after nitroglycerin is more frequent in the elderly and must be anticipated. ASA, oxygen to keep SpO2 at or above 94%, position of comfort and prompt transport all still apply, and Entonox may be considered for pain.
questions.explanationZh: 两项禁忌同时成立。他的收缩压 104 mmHg，低于 110 mmHg 阈值；而 tadalafil（Cialis）的禁忌窗口是 48 小时，而非 Viagra 和 Levitra 的 24 小时，所以 30 小时仍在窗口内。A 项套错了药物的时间窗。C 项事实错误——这条规定覆盖三种药，只是时间不同。D 项凭空造了一个不存在的“年龄禁忌”；年龄本身永远不是禁忌，不过老年人用 nitroglycerin 后更容易低血压，必须预先防范。ASA、给氧维持 SpO2 ≥ 94%、舒适体位和尽快转运仍然适用，疼痛可考虑 Entonox。

questions.questionEn: A 12-year-old girl has had periumbilical pain for 14 hours that has now settled in the right lower quadrant. She has vomited twice, will not eat, and lies very still with her knees drawn up. HR 104, RR 20, BP 108/66, SpO2 99% on room air, temperature 38.1°C. Her abdomen is tender in the right lower quadrant with guarding. She has had no diarrhoea and no urinary symptoms. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.questionZh: 一名 12 岁女童脐周疼痛已 14 小时，现在疼痛固定到右下腹。她吐了两次，不肯吃东西，躺着不敢动并屈膝。HR 104，RR 20，BP 108/66，室内空气下 SpO2 99%，体温 38.1°C。右下腹压痛并有肌紧张。无腹泻，无泌尿系统症状。最可能的诊断是什么？

options.zh: Appendicitis（阑尾炎）
Gastroenteritis（胃肠炎）
Constipation（便秘）
Urinary tract infection（尿路感染）

questions.explanationEn: Pain that migrates from the umbilicus to the right lower quadrant over hours, with anorexia, vomiting, a low-grade fever, guarding and a reluctance to move, is appendicitis. Both the migration and the order of symptoms — pain first, then vomiting — are discriminating. Gastroenteritis is excluded: it usually starts with vomiting and diarrhoea, produces diffuse crampy pain that comes and goes, and lets the patient move about; the profile explicitly states there is no diarrhoea. Constipation is excluded: it does not cause fever, guarding, or a child who will not move. Urinary tract infection is excluded: no urinary symptoms are reported, and abnormal findings would have been stated. Give nothing by mouth, keep her in a position of comfort and transport.
questions.explanationZh: 疼痛在数小时内从脐周转移到右下腹，伴食欲全无、呕吐、低热、肌紧张和不敢移动，这是 appendicitis（阑尾炎）。“疼痛转移”和“先痛后吐”的顺序都是关键鉴别点。Gastroenteritis（胃肠炎）可以排除：它通常先吐先泻，疼痛是弥漫性、阵发性的，患者可以走动；而题干明写无腹泻。Constipation（便秘）可以排除：不会发热、不会肌紧张，也不会让孩子不敢动。Urinary tract infection（尿路感染）可以排除：题干未提及任何泌尿系统症状，而异常一定会写出来。处理：禁食禁水、舒适体位、转运。

questions.questionEn: A 72-year-old man with hypertension and a long smoking history has sudden severe abdominal and back pain that began 20 minutes ago. HR 122, RR 24, BP 84/52, SpO2 96% on room air, temperature 36.5°C. He is pale and clammy, there is a tender pulsatile mass above the umbilicus, and his femoral pulses are unequal. Which diagnosis and PCP management is correct?
questions.questionZh: 一名 72 岁、有高血压和长期吸烟史的男性，20 分钟前突发剧烈腹痛和背痛。HR 122，RR 24，BP 84/52，室内空气下 SpO2 96%，体温 36.5°C。面色苍白、皮肤湿冷，脐上可触及搏动性包块且压痛，双侧股动脉强度不等。下列哪一项的诊断和 PCP 处置是正确的？

options.en: Renal colic — consider analgesia and transport
options.zh: Renal colic（肾绞痛）——考虑镇痛并转运

options.en: Small bowel obstruction — consider an antiemetic and transport
options.zh: Small bowel obstruction（小肠梗阻）——考虑止吐药并转运

options.en: Pancreatitis — position of comfort and transport
options.zh: Pancreatitis（胰腺炎）——舒适体位并转运

options.en: Ruptured abdominal aortic aneurysm — treat under the hypovolemia guideline with vascular access and a titrated fluid bolus reassessed every 500 mL, limit movement and deep palpation, and transport rapidly with early notification
options.zh: Ruptured abdominal aortic aneurysm（腹主动脉瘤破裂）——按低容量指引处理：建立静脉通路、滴定输液并每 500 mL 重评，减少搬动和深部触诊，快速转运并提前通知

questions.explanationEn: A tender pulsatile abdominal mass with sudden abdominal and back pain, hypotension and unequal femoral pulses in an older hypertensive smoker is a ruptured or leaking abdominal aortic aneurysm. Renal colic is excluded: it produces colicky loin-to-groin pain in a patient who cannot lie still, and it does not cause hypotension, a pulsatile mass or unequal femoral pulses. Small bowel obstruction is excluded: it develops over hours to days with distension, vomiting and absent flatus, not in 20 minutes with shock. Pancreatitis is a genuine overlap because its epigastric pain also radiates to the back, but it does not produce a pulsatile mass or asymmetric femoral pulses. Handle him gently, avoid deep palpation, keep him warm, and remember that fluid should be titrated rather than poured in.
questions.explanationZh: 老年高血压吸烟者突发腹背痛，伴低血压、脐上搏动性压痛包块和双侧股动脉不对称，这是腹主动脉瘤破裂或渗漏。Renal colic（肾绞痛）可以排除：它是从腰向腹股沟放射的阵发性绞痛，患者辗转不安，不会造成低血压、搏动性包块或股动脉不对称。Small bowel obstruction（小肠梗阻）可以排除：它在数小时到数天内发展，伴腹胀、呕吐、停止排气，不会 20 分钟内休克。Pancreatitis（胰腺炎）确实有重叠——上腹痛也向背部放射——但它不会产生搏动性包块或不对称的股动脉。处理：轻柔搬动、避免深部触诊、保暖，并记住液体要滴定而不是猛灌。

questions.questionEn: A 27-year-old woman collapses at work after sudden severe left lower quadrant pain. She is conscious and pale. HR 128, RR 26, BP 82/50, SpO2 97% on room air, temperature 36.4°C. Her radial pulse is weak, her abdomen is tender in the left lower quadrant, and she denies any vaginal bleeding. Her last menstrual period was seven weeks ago. Which diagnosis and PCP management is correct?
questions.questionZh: 一名 27 岁女性在工作时突发左下腹剧痛后晕倒。她神智清醒但面色苍白。HR 128，RR 26，BP 82/50，室内空气下 SpO2 97%，体温 36.4°C。桡动脉微弱，左下腹压痛，她否认有阴道出血。最后一次月经是七周前。下列哪一项的诊断和 PCP 处置是正确的？

options.en: Ruptured ectopic pregnancy — position supine, give oxygen, obtain vascular access and give a fluid bolus under the hypovolemia guideline, and transport rapidly
options.zh: Ruptured ectopic pregnancy（宫外孕破裂）——平卧位、给氧、建立静脉通路并按低容量指引输液，快速转运

options.en: Ovarian cyst pain — give analgesia and transport routinely
options.zh: Ovarian cyst（卵巢囊肿）疼痛——镇痛后常规转运

options.en: Urinary tract infection — transport for antibiotics
options.zh: Urinary tract infection（尿路感染）——转运到院用抗生素
Gastroenteritis（胃肠炎）——考虑 ondansetron 并转运

questions.explanationEn: Lower quadrant pain with shock and a missed period in a woman of childbearing age is a ruptured ectopic pregnancy until proven otherwise, and the absence of vaginal bleeding does not exclude it — the bleeding is intra-abdominal, which is precisely why she is in shock without any visible blood loss. Ovarian cyst pain is excluded on ranking: a cyst rarely produces this degree of shock, and even where it might, the ectopic must be excluded first because it is the one that kills. Urinary tract infection is excluded: she is afebrile with no urinary symptoms, and infection does not cause an instantaneous collapse with a systolic of 82 mmHg. Gastroenteritis is excluded: no vomiting, no diarrhoea, and her pain is focal rather than diffuse and crampy. Manage under the hypovolemia guideline with a 20 mL/kg bolus to a maximum of 2 litres, reassessing every 500 mL.
questions.explanationZh: 育龄期女性下腹疼痛、休克加上月经推迟，在排除之前就是 ruptured ectopic pregnancy（宫外孕破裂）；而“没有阴道出血”并不能排除它——出血在腹腔内，这正是她看不到出血却休克的原因。Ovarian cyst（卵巢囊肿）疼痛从排序上排除：囊肿很少造成这种程度的休克；即使有可能，也必须先排除会死人的宫外孕。Urinary tract infection（尿路感染）可以排除：不发热、无泌尿症状，且感染不会造成瞬间晕倒并使收缩压降到 82 mmHg。Gastroenteritis（胃肠炎）可以排除：无呕吐、无腹泻，且疼痛是局限性而非弥漫绞痛。按低容量指引 20 mL/kg（最多 2 L）输液，每 500 mL 重评。

questions.questionEn: A 52-year-old woman has had severe right upper quadrant pain for 5 hours. It began two hours after a fatty meal and radiates to her right shoulder blade, and she has vomited three times. HR 96, RR 18, BP 138/84, SpO2 98% on room air, temperature 38.2°C. Her right upper quadrant is tender with guarding. She has no chest pain, no diaphoresis and no shortness of breath. Which diagnosis and PCP management is correct?
questions.questionZh: 一名 52 岁女性右上腹剧痛已 5 小时，疼痛在一顿油腻饭后两小时开始，并向右肩胛放射，已吐了三次。HR 96，RR 18，BP 138/84，室内空气下 SpO2 98%，体温 38.2°C。右上腹压痛并有肌紧张。无胸痛、无大汗、无气促。下列哪一项的诊断和 PCP 处置是正确的？

options.en: Acute myocardial infarction — give ASA and manage under the cardiac chest pain protocol
options.zh: Acute myocardial infarction（急性心肌梗死）——给 ASA 并按心源性胸痛协议处理

options.en: Appendicitis — position of comfort and transport
options.zh: Appendicitis（阑尾炎）——舒适体位并转运
Renal colic（肾绞痛）——镇痛并转运

options.en: Cholecystitis — position of comfort, consider an antiemetic such as ondansetron or dimenhydrinate, and transport
options.zh: Cholecystitis（胆囊炎）——舒适体位，考虑 ondansetron 或 dimenhydrinate 止吐，并转运

questions.explanationEn: Right upper quadrant pain beginning after a fatty meal, radiating to the right scapula, with fever, vomiting and right upper quadrant guarding, is cholecystitis. Acute myocardial infarction is the near miss that must always be considered with upper abdominal pain, because inferior infarcts present this way — but she has no chest pain, no diaphoresis and no shortness of breath, and the meal-related onset with fever and focal right upper quadrant tenderness makes biliary disease far more likely; if any cardiac feature appeared, the ranking would flip immediately. Appendicitis is excluded: its tenderness is in the right lower quadrant and its pain migrates from the umbilicus. Renal colic is excluded: it is colicky loin-to-groin pain in a patient who cannot lie still, without fever or a food trigger. Give nothing by mouth and keep suction ready.
questions.explanationZh: 油腻饭后发作的右上腹疼痛，向右肩胛放射，伴发热、呕吐和右上腹肌紧张，这是 cholecystitis（胆囊炎）。Acute myocardial infarction（急性心肌梗死）是上腹痛时永远要想到的鉴别项，因为下壁梗死就是这么表现的——但她无胸痛、无大汗、无气促，而“饭后发作 + 发热 + 右上腹局限压痛”使胆道疾病可能性高得多；一旦出现任何心源性特征，排序就要立即反转。Appendicitis（阑尾炎）可以排除：它的压痛在右下腹，且疼痛从脐周转移。Renal colic（肾绞痛）可以排除：它是从腰向腹股沟放射的绞痛，患者辗转不安，无发热也与进食无关。处理上禁食禁水，并备好吸引。

questions.questionEn: A 58-year-old man who had abdominal surgery years ago has 18 hours of colicky central abdominal pain with repeated vomiting that is now bilious. He has passed no stool and no flatus since yesterday. HR 110, RR 20, BP 118/74, SpO2 97% on room air, temperature 37.1°C. His abdomen is distended and tympanic with generalized mild tenderness but no guarding, and there is no pulsatile mass. Which diagnosis and PCP management is correct?
questions.questionZh: 一名 58 岁男性多年前做过腹部手术，现在脐周阵发性绞痛已 18 小时，反复呕吐，呕吐物已变为胆汁性。从昨天起无排便也无排气。HR 110，RR 20，BP 118/74，室内空气下 SpO2 97%，体温 37.1°C。腹部膨隆、叩之鼓音，弥漫轻度压痛但无肌紧张，无搏动性包块。下列哪一项的诊断和 PCP 处置是正确的？

options.en: Gastroenteritis — encourage oral fluids on scene
options.zh: Gastroenteritis（胃肠炎）——在现场鼓励口服补液

options.en: Small bowel obstruction — nothing by mouth, position of comfort with suction ready, consider vascular access and an antiemetic, and treat hypotension from volume loss with a 20 mL/kg bolus targeting a systolic of 90 mmHg
options.zh: Small bowel obstruction（小肠梗阻）——禁食禁水、舒适体位并备好吸引，考虑建立静脉通路和止吐药；若因失液出现低血压，按 20 mL/kg 输液，目标收缩压 90 mmHg
Appendicitis（阑尾炎）——按肌紧张患者转运

options.en: Ruptured abdominal aortic aneurysm — treat under the hypovolemia guideline
options.zh: Ruptured abdominal aortic aneurysm（腹主动脉瘤破裂）——按低容量指引处理

questions.explanationEn: Colicky pain with bilious vomiting, abdominal distension and no stool or flatus, in a patient with previous abdominal surgery and therefore adhesions, is small bowel obstruction. Gastroenteritis is excluded: it produces diarrhoea, not obstipation, and encouraging oral fluid in an obstructed vomiting patient risks aspiration. Appendicitis is excluded: it localizes to the right lower quadrant with guarding and does not produce distension with absent flatus in this pattern. Ruptured abdominal aortic aneurysm is excluded: no pulsatile mass, no back pain, no hypotension, and an 18-hour course rather than an instantaneous one. Ongoing vomiting causes real volume loss, so reassess for hypotension; the BC nausea and vomiting guideline allows PCPs to consider dimenhydrinate or ondansetron and to treat volume loss with a 20 mL/kg bolus to a maximum of 2 litres, reassessing every 500 mL.
questions.explanationZh: 阵发性绞痛、胆汁性呕吐、腹胀、停止排便排气，发生在有腹部手术史（因而有粘连）的患者身上，这是 small bowel obstruction（小肠梗阻）。Gastroenteritis（胃肠炎）可以排除：它表现为腹泻而不是停止排便，而且让一个正在呕吐的梗阻患者喝水有误吸风险。Appendicitis（阑尾炎）可以排除：它定位在右下腹并伴肌紧张，不会以腹胀加停止排气这种方式表现。Ruptured abdominal aortic aneurysm（腹主动脉瘤破裂）可以排除：无搏动性包块、无背痛、无低血压，且病程 18 小时而非瞬间。持续呕吐会造成真实失液，需反复重评血压；BC 恶心呕吐指引允许 PCP 考虑 dimenhydrinate 或 ondansetron，并对失液性低血压按 20 mL/kg（最多 2 L）输液、每 500 mL 重评。

questions.questionEn: A 10-month-old boy has had episodes every 15 to 20 minutes for the past 6 hours in which he screams, draws his knees up and goes pale, then falls limp and quiet between episodes. He has vomited twice. HR 168, RR 40, BP 84/50, SpO2 97% on room air, temperature 37.3°C. His nappy contains dark red jelly-like stool and there is a sausage-shaped mass palpable in the right upper abdomen. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.questionZh: 一名 10 个月大的男婴过去 6 小时内每 15–20 分钟发作一次：尖叫、屈膝、面色发白；发作间隙则瘫软安静。已呕吐两次。HR 168，RR 40，BP 84/50，室内空气下 SpO2 97%，体温 37.3°C。尿布上有暗红色果酱样便，右上腹可触及一个腊肠样包块。最可能的诊断是什么？

options.zh: Intussusception（肠套叠）
Gastroenteritis（胃肠炎）
Constipation（便秘）
Hypertrophic pyloric stenosis（肥厚性幽门狭窄）

questions.explanationEn: Intermittent colic with pallor during attacks and lethargy between them, a sausage-shaped abdominal mass and redcurrant-jelly stool, in an infant of this age, is intussusception. Gastroenteritis is excluded: it produces watery diarrhoea with continuous rather than strictly episodic pain, and it does not produce a palpable mass. Constipation is excluded: it does not cause bloody stool, a mass, or a lethargic infant with a heart rate of 168. Hypertrophic pyloric stenosis is excluded by age and by symptom pattern: it presents at roughly 3 to 8 weeks of age with forceful non-bilious vomiting in a hungry infant, not with colic and bloody stool at 10 months. The limpness between attacks is what makes this time-critical — treat him as unstable, give nothing by mouth and transport.
questions.explanationZh: 阵发性绞痛、发作时面色发白、间隙期瘫软嗜睡，加上腊肠样包块和果酱样血便，在这个月龄就是 intussusception（肠套叠）。Gastroenteritis（胃肠炎）可以排除：它是水样腹泻加持续性而非严格阵发性的疼痛，也不会摸到包块。Constipation（便秘）可以排除：不会有血便、包块，也不会让婴儿瘫软且心率高达 168。Hypertrophic pyloric stenosis（肥厚性幽门狭窄）可以从年龄和症状模式两方面排除：它多在出生后 3–8 周发病，表现为饥饿的婴儿喷射性、非胆汁性呕吐，而不是 10 个月时的绞痛加血便。发作间隙的瘫软才是真正紧急的信号——按不稳定患者处理、禁食禁水、尽快转运。

questions.questionEn: A 3-week-old boy has been vomiting immediately after every feed for four days. The vomit is forceful and non-bilious, and he is hungry again straight afterwards. HR 176, RR 44, SpO2 98% on room air, temperature 36.7°C, blood glucose 3.2 mmol/L. His anterior fontanelle is sunken, his nappies have been dry for 8 hours and his capillary refill is 4 seconds. His abdomen is soft and not distended. Which diagnosis and PCP management is correct?
questions.questionZh: 一名出生 3 周的男婴连续四天每次吃完奶就呕吐，吐得很用力、吐物不含胆汁，吐完马上又饿。HR 176，RR 44，室内空气下 SpO2 98%，体温 36.7°C，血糖 3.2 mmol/L。前囟凹陷，尿布已连续 8 小时干燥，毛细血管再充盈 4 秒。腹部柔软、无膨隆。下列哪一项的诊断和 PCP 处置是正确的？

options.en: Gastroesophageal reflux — reassure the parents and advise smaller, more frequent feeds
options.zh: Gastroesophageal reflux（胃食管反流）——安抚家长，建议少量多餐

options.en: Malrotation with volvulus — nothing by mouth and transport
options.zh: Malrotation with volvulus（肠旋转不良伴扭转）——禁食禁水并转运

options.en: Neonatal sepsis — oxygen and transport only
options.zh: Neonatal sepsis（新生儿脓毒症）——只给氧并转运

options.en: Hypertrophic pyloric stenosis with dehydration and hypoglycemia — correct the confirmed blood glucose below 4.0 mmol/L, obtain vascular access, treat the hypoperfusion with a weight-based fluid bolus reassessing frequently, keep him warm, and transport
options.zh: Hypertrophic pyloric stenosis（肥厚性幽门狭窄）并脱水、低血糖——纠正已确认低于 4.0 mmol/L 的血糖，建立静脉通路，按体重输液纠正低灌注并频繁重评，保暖，并转运

questions.explanationEn: Forceful non-bilious vomiting after every feed in a hungry infant of about 3 weeks, together with a sunken fontanelle, dry nappies and a capillary refill of 4 seconds, is hypertrophic pyloric stenosis with significant dehydration. The immediate prehospital problems are the hypoperfusion and the blood glucose of 3.2 mmol/L, which is below the 4.0 mmol/L threshold the guidelines direct you to correct. Gastroesophageal reflux is excluded: reflux is effortless posseting and does not produce a sunken fontanelle, dry nappies or delayed capillary refill, and 'reassure and advise' would send a shocked infant home. Malrotation with volvulus is excluded on the profile: it produces bilious vomiting with a distended tender abdomen, and this vomit is explicitly non-bilious with a soft abdomen. Neonatal sepsis remains a consideration in any unwell neonate, but he is afebrile and the vomiting is mechanically patterned after every feed — and 'transport only' would leave both the glucose and the hypoperfusion untreated.
questions.explanationZh: 约 3 周大的婴儿每次吃完奶都用力吐、吐物不含胆汁且吐完又饿，加上前囟凹陷、尿布干燥、再充盈 4 秒，这是肥厚性幽门狭窄并严重脱水。院前最紧迫的两个问题是低灌注和血糖 3.2 mmol/L——低于指引要求纠正的 4.0 mmol/L 阈值。Gastroesophageal reflux（胃食管反流）可以排除：反流是毫不费力地溢奶，不会造成前囟凹陷、尿布干燥或再充盈延长；而“安抚家长”会把一个已经休克的婴儿留在家里。Malrotation with volvulus（肠旋转不良伴扭转）按题干可以排除：它是胆汁性呕吐加腹胀压痛，而本例明写吐物不含胆汁、腹部柔软。Neonatal sepsis（新生儿脓毒症）在任何不适的新生儿身上都要考虑，但他不发热、且呕吐与喂奶完全同步呈机械性规律；而且“只转运”会把血糖和低灌注都扔下不管。

questions.questionEn: A 44-year-old man has had headache, nausea and dizziness for three days, worse in the evenings at home and better while he is at work. His wife and their teenage son have had the same headaches this week, and the family dog has been unwell. HR 98, RR 20, BP 132/80, SpO2 98% on room air, temperature 36.8°C. His chest is clear and he has no cough, no sore throat and no fever. Their gas furnace was serviced last month. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.questionZh: 一名 44 岁男性头痛、恶心、头晕已三天，晚上在家时加重、上班时反而好转。本周他太太和青春期的儿子也有同样的头痛，家里的狗也不对劲。HR 98，RR 20，BP 132/80，室内空气下 SpO2 98%，体温 36.8°C。听诊双肺清晰，无咳嗽、无咽痛、无发热。他们家的燃气锅炉上个月刚做过维护。最可能的诊断是什么？

options.zh: Influenza（流感）
Migraine（偏头痛）
Carbon monoxide poisoning（一氧化碳中毒）
Viral gastroenteritis（病毒性胃肠炎）

questions.explanationEn: Headaches affecting several people in the same household, worse at home and better away from it, with the family pet also unwell and no fever or respiratory symptoms, is carbon monoxide poisoning. The SpO2 of 98% is the trap: a standard pulse oximeter cannot distinguish carboxyhaemoglobin from oxyhaemoglobin, so a normal reading tells you nothing about tissue oxygenation here. Influenza is excluded: it causes fever, cough and sore throat, it does not improve when the patient leaves the house, and it does not make the dog unwell. Migraine is excluded: it does not spread through a household on a schedule tied to being at home. Viral gastroenteritis is excluded: no diarrhoea and no fever, and headache rather than gut symptoms dominates. Evacuate everyone, alert the fire department, and give high-flow oxygen by non-rebreather, which the BC guidelines specify for carbon monoxide poisoning.
questions.explanationZh: 同一个屋檐下好几个人同时头痛，在家重、离家轻，连宠物也不对劲，且无发热无呼吸道症状，这是 carbon monoxide poisoning（一氧化碳中毒）。SpO2 98% 正是陷阱：普通脉搏氧饱仪无法区分碳氧血红蛋白与氧合血红蛋白，所以正常读数在这里完全不能说明组织氧合。Influenza（流感）可以排除：流感会发热、咳嗽、咽痛，不会一出门就好转，也不会把狗一起弄病。Migraine（偏头痛）可以排除：它不会按“在不在家”的规律在全家传开。Viral gastroenteritis（病毒性胃肠炎）可以排除：无腹泻无发热，主诉也是头痛而非胃肠症状。处理：把所有人撤出建筑物、通知消防，并按 BC 指引对一氧化碳中毒的规定用面罩（non-rebreather）给高流量氧。

questions.questionEn: A 28-year-old runner collapses at the finish line of a race on a 34°C day. HR 148, RR 30, BP 96/58, SpO2 97% on room air, tympanic temperature 40.6°C, blood glucose 5.4 mmol/L. He is confused and does not know where he is, and his skin is hot. Which diagnosis and management is correct?
questions.questionZh: 一名 28 岁跑者在 34°C 的天气下于终点处晕倒。HR 148，RR 30，BP 96/58，室内空气下 SpO2 97%，鼓膜体温 40.6°C，血糖 5.4 mmol/L。他神智混乱，说不出自己在哪里，皮肤灼热。下列哪一项的诊断和处理是正确的？

options.en: Heat exhaustion — move him to shade, give oral fluids and monitor
options.zh: Heat exhaustion（热衰竭）——移到阴凉处、口服补液并观察

options.en: Simple exercise-associated collapse — lie him down and reassess in 10 minutes
options.zh: 单纯的运动后晕倒——让他躺下，10 分钟后再评估

options.en: Hyponatremia — restrict all fluids and transport without cooling
options.zh: Hyponatremia（低钠血症）——限制一切液体并在不降温的情况下转运

options.en: Heat stroke — remove all clothing, begin aggressive evaporative and convective cooling, continue cooling for at least 10 minutes before conveyance and throughout transport, and consider fluid replacement at PCP level
options.zh: Heat stroke（热射病）——脱去全部衣物，立即开始积极的蒸发降温和对流降温，至少降温 10 分钟后再启程并在转运全程继续降温，PCP 另可考虑补液

questions.explanationEn: A core temperature of 40.6°C together with an altered mental status is heat stroke, and the altered mental status is exactly the line that separates it from heat exhaustion. Heat exhaustion is excluded: those patients have a normal or only mildly raised core temperature with an intact mental status, and giving oral fluid to a confused patient is an aspiration risk. Simple exercise-associated collapse is excluded: it does not come with 40.6°C and confusion, and 'reassess in 10 minutes' wastes the window in which cooling protects the brain. Hyponatremia is a genuine consideration in endurance athletes and can also cause confusion, but it does not explain a core temperature of 40.6°C, and cooling must never be delayed while that is debated. The BC guideline directs removing all clothing, cold wet towels to head, torso and thighs, air conditioning on maximum cold, immersion of the feet and legs where available, and a blood glucose measurement because his level of consciousness is decreased.
questions.explanationZh: 核心体温 40.6°C 同时伴神智改变，这就是 heat stroke（热射病）；而“神智是否改变”正是它与 heat exhaustion 的分界线。Heat exhaustion（热衰竭）可以排除：那些患者核心体温正常或仅轻度升高、神智清楚，而且让神智混乱的人口服补液有误吸风险。“单纯运动后晕倒”可以排除：它不会伴 40.6°C 和混乱，而“10 分钟后再看”会浪费降温保脑的黄金窗口。Hyponatremia（低钠血症）在耐力运动员中确实需要考虑且也会造成神智改变，但它解释不了 40.6°C 的核心体温，而且绝不能为了争这个而延误降温。BC 指引要求：脱光衣物，用冰湿毛巾敷头部、躯干和大腿，救护车空调开到最冷，有条件时把双脚双腿浸入冰水，并因意识下降而必须测血糖。

questions.questionEn: A 52-year-old hiker is found shivering and confused after a night out in the rain. His core temperature is 30.5°C, HR 44, RR 10, BP 100/60. Which classification and management does the BC guideline direct?
questions.questionZh: 一名 52 岁徒步者在雨中过了一夜后被找到，全身发抖、神智混乱。核心体温 30.5°C，HR 44，RR 10，BP 100/60。按 BC 指引，应归为哪一类并如何处理？

options.en: Mild hypothermia — no active rewarming is required
options.zh: 轻度 hypothermia（低体温）——不需要主动复温

options.en: Moderate hypothermia — remove wet clothing and actively rewarm with heat packs wrapped in towels, warm blankets, and the ambulance preheated to 30°C
options.zh: 中度 hypothermia（低体温）——脱掉湿衣物，用毛巾包裹的热包、温暖的毯子主动复温，并将救护车内预热到 30°C

options.en: Severe hypothermia — do not actively rewarm; insulate only
options.zh: 重度 hypothermia（低体温）——不主动复温，只做保温隔离

options.en: Normothermia — no thermal management is required
options.zh: 体温正常——不需要任何体温管理

questions.explanationEn: The BC bands are mild above 32°C and below 35°C, moderate above 28°C and below 32°C, and severe below 28°C. At 30.5°C he falls in the moderate band, and the guideline directs active rewarming for both the mild and moderate bands: remove wet and cold clothing, cover with blankets or dry clothing, use hot packs wrapped in towels, and preheat the ambulance interior to 30°C. Option A misclassifies him and also misstates the mild band, which does call for active rewarming. Option C applies the severe band, where active rewarming is withheld and the patient is insulated and handled gently instead — applying it here would leave a rewarmable patient cold. Option D is simply wrong at 30.5°C. Handle him gently in any case, and remember that in a severely hypothermic patient you take 30 to 45 seconds to determine pulselessness.
questions.explanationZh: BC 的分期是：轻度为 > 32°C 且 < 35°C，中度为 > 28°C 且 < 32°C，重度为 < 28°C。 30.5°C 落在中度区间，而指引对轻度和中度都要求主动复温：脱掉湿冷衣物，盖毯子或换干衣服，使用用毛巾包裹的热包，并将救护车内预热到 30°C。A 项分期错了，而且也说错了轻度区间的处理——轻度同样要主动复温。C 项套用了重度区间的规则（不主动复温、只保温并避免粗暴搬动），在这里用会把一个本可复温的患者凉在那里。D 项在 30.5°C 下纯属错误。无论哪一期都要轻柔搬动；另记住，对重度低体温患者判断是否无脉需要花 30–45 秒。

questions.questionEn: An 11-year-old was pulled from a lake after about 4 minutes underwater. She is conscious and following commands but coughing, shivering violently and short of breath. HR 118, RR 32, BP 104/64, SpO2 89% on high-flow oxygen, tympanic temperature 33.8°C. She has crackles in both lung bases and no evidence of trauma. Which statement best explains her hypoxia and directs management?
questions.questionZh: 一名 11 岁女童在水下约 4 分钟后被从湖里救起。她神智清醒、能遵从指令，但不停咳嗽、剧烈发抖、气促。HR 118，RR 32，BP 104/64，高流量氧下 SpO2 89%，鼓膜体温 33.8°C。双肺底有湿啰音，无创伤证据。下列哪一项最能解释她的低氧并指导处置？

options.en: Water swallowed into her stomach is splinting her diaphragm; it must be expelled before oxygenation will improve
options.zh: 咽入胃里的水顶住了横膈；必须先把水排出来氧合才会改善

options.en: Aspirated water has damaged the alveolar membrane and washed out surfactant, causing pulmonary oedema; keep her at rest sitting up, remove her wet clothing and dry her, actively rewarm, and support ventilation with a bag-valve mask and PEEP valve if she deteriorates
options.zh: 吸入的水损伤了肺泡膜并冲走了表面活性物质，导致肺水肿；让她静止坐起、脱掉湿衣服并擦干、主动复温，若恶化则用 BVM 加 PEEP 阀辅助通气

options.en: The hypoxia is entirely due to hypothermia and will resolve with rewarming alone
options.zh: 低氧完全是低体温造成的，只要复温就会自行缓解

options.en: Shivering is consuming her oxygen; suppress it by leaving her in her wet clothing to avoid stimulation
options.zh: 发抖在消耗氧；为避免刺激，让她穿着湿衣服不要动

questions.explanationEn: Bilateral basal crackles after submersion reflect aspirated water damaging the alveolar-capillary membrane and washing out surfactant, producing pulmonary oedema and shunt — which is why the BC drowning guideline directs keeping the patient at rest, sitting them up, removing wet clothing and drying them, avoiding rough handling, maintaining body temperature, and using PEEP or CPAP if indicated. Note that CPAP is contraindicated at 12 years of age and under, so for this child the route is assisted ventilation by bag-valve mask with a PEEP valve if she deteriorates. Option A is a persistent myth: attempts to expel water from the stomach provoke vomiting and aspiration and are not part of the guideline. Option C is wrong because hypothermia at 33.8°C does not explain crackles with an SpO2 of 89% on high-flow oxygen, although the hypothermia must be treated too — she is in the mild band, so active rewarming applies. Option D is backwards and harmful: wet clothing guarantees continued heat loss.
questions.explanationZh: 溺水后双肺底湿啰音，反映的是吸入的水损伤肺泡-毛细血管膜、冲走表面活性物质，造成肺水肿和分流——这也正是 BC 溺水指引要求“保持静止、坐起、脱湿衣并擦干、避免粗暴搬动、维持体温、必要时用 PEEP 或 CPAP”的原因。请注意：CPAP 对 12 岁及以下是禁忌，所以这名患儿一旦恶化，路径是 BVM 加 PEEP 阀的辅助通气。A 项是流传已久的谬误：试图把胃里的水挤出来只会引发呕吐和误吸，指引中并无此项。C 项错在 33.8°C 的低体温解释不了“高流量氧下 SpO2 仍只有 89% 且有湿啰音”；不过低体温同样要处理——她处于轻度区间，适用主动复温。D 项方向完全搞反且有害：穿着湿衣服只会让体温持续下降。

questions.questionEn: Paramedics attend an unplanned delivery at home. A term newborn was delivered 4 minutes before their arrival and has been lying uncovered on the bathroom floor. He is crying vigorously with good tone, his heart rate is 148, and he is pink centrally. His skin is cold to touch and he is still wet with amniotic fluid. The room temperature is 18°C. What is the priority problem and the correct action?
questions.questionZh: 救护员前往一起家中的非计划分娩。一名足月新生儿在他们到达前 4 分钟出生，一直没盖任何东西地躺在浴室地板上。他哭声洪亮、肌张力良好，心率 148，中心性肤色红润。皮肤摸上去冰凉，身上还湿着羊水。室温 18°C。优先问题是什么，正确的处置是什么？

options.en: He is in respiratory distress and needs bag-valve-mask ventilation
options.zh: 他处于呼吸窘迫，需要 BVM 辅助通气

options.en: He needs chest compressions because his heart rate is below 100
options.zh: 他需要胸外按压，因为心率低于 100

options.en: He is losing heat rapidly by evaporation and conduction — dry him thoroughly, remove the wet linen, wrap him including his head, place him skin-to-skin with his mother and keep the environment warm
options.zh: 他正在通过蒸发和传导迅速失热——彻底擦干、拿走湿布单、连头部一起包裹，让他与母亲皮肤接触，并保持环境温暖

options.en: He is stable and needs no thermal intervention because he is crying and pink
options.zh: 他很稳定，因为已经在哭且肤色红润，不需要任何体温处理

questions.explanationEn: A wet newborn on a cold floor loses heat extremely fast by evaporation and conduction, and neonatal hypothermia worsens hypoxia, acidosis and hypoglycemia; the first step of the BC newborn sequence is to dry, stimulate and keep warm. Option A is wrong on the findings: he is crying vigorously with good tone and is pink centrally, so his respiratory effort is adequate and ventilating him is unnecessary and potentially harmful. Option B misapplies the newborn algorithm: his heart rate is 148, well above the 100 bpm threshold that prompts escalation, and compressions are reached only when the rate remains below 60 after ventilation with oxygen. Option D mistakes present stability for safety — a vigorous newborn can become hypothermic within minutes, and prevention is the intervention. Keep him warm en route and reassess his heart rate, tone and colour continuously.
